issues.label: Wall roughness
issues.explanation: Fluent modifies the wall law using roughness height and constant. Kutta currently implements smooth-wall laws only, so roughness drag and y-plus cannot be reproduced. Adapter detail: inactive model flag retained; does not apply to the selected viscous model.

issues.label: k-epsilon model controls
issues.explanation: Fluent uses this switch or coefficient in the k-epsilon closure or its wall treatment. Kutta implements the standard model with standard wall functions and Fluent's default coefficients; other variants are not adapted. Adapter detail: inactive model flag retained; does not apply to the selected viscous model.

issues.label: SST wall omega treatment
issues.explanation: Fluent selects a wall-omega correlation or a tabulated law. Kutta implements the correlation only; the alternative table is unavailable. Correlation face-omega offset was about 0.42% on the saved Fluent 22.2 elbow fields; this is not a flow-solution error bound. Adapter detail: inactive model flag retained; does not apply to the selected viscous model.

issues.label: Pressure-outlet reverse flow
issues.explanation: Fluent can suppress flow entering through a pressure outlet. Cases written by Fluent 18.0 and earlier do not record whether that was on, and the earlier behaviour is undocumented. Kutta runs without suppression only when you opt in with --approximate reverse-flow. suppression acts only on outlet faces with inflow; for the Fluent 18.0 Re 40 cylinder, none of the outlet's 30 faces has inflow in Fluent's saved converged fields or in Kutta's converged CPU and Metal solutions, so the effect there is zero; other cases need their own check.
issues.measured_effect: suppression acts only on outlet faces with inflow; for the Fluent 18.0 Re 40 cylinder, none of the outlet's 30 faces has inflow in Fluent's saved converged fields or in Kutta's converged CPU and Metal solutions, so the effect there is zero; other cases need their own check
